plugin.name: The Warriors Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)
skip.description: Skip startup intros. Restart after changing this option.
fps.description: Enable the native 60 FPS patch. Restart after changing this option.
aspect.description: Auto follows the emulator's aspect ratio. Enter width:height (for example 16:9) to force one, or 0 to keep the original picture and HUD. Restart after changes.
loading.description: Speeds up level loading screens. Restart after changes.
DualAnalogPatch.description: Use the right stick for the camera and keep the left stick for movement. Needs a restart.
